notation: BPMN 2.0.2 (formal/13-12-09), element names only; no XML/DI, no engine
status: Synthetic order process and hand-written trace; not a client system, not executed on a BPMN engine.

process.note: approve-manual and approve-auto both lead to split; check-stock and check-credit lead to join; join leads to ship.

trace.status: hand-written token trace (Evidence), not an engine log

tokens.note: i2 has not yet produced a stock token

rules_read.10.6.2 (p. 289-290): Diverging Exclusive Gateway: for a given process instance only one path can be taken; default path if no condition is true, otherwise runtime exception.
rules_read.13.4.2 (p. 435): Each arriving token activates the gateway and is routed to exactly one outgoing flow; conditions evaluated in order, first true wins; default iff none true; exception if none and no default.
rules_read.13.4.1 (p. 434): Parallel Gateway is activated if there is at least one token on each incoming flow; consumes exactly one token per incoming flow, produces one per outgoing flow; excess tokens remain.
rules_read.13.2 (p. 426): Each Start Event occurrence creates a new process instance (unless correlated); completion requires no token remaining within the process instance.
rules_read.13.3.1 (p. 427) / Glossary (p. 502): Token is a theoretical concept to define behaviour; tools are not required to implement tokens.
